column1: # 구결자 in the Hanyang private-use convention (한양 PUA), U+F67E to U+F77C.
# The code points are 한/글's: its word processor places 255 구결자 in the Private Use Area, and no
# Unicode or ISO/IEC 10646 block holds them. 하정수 (2019), 「국제 표준 문자 코드 登錄을 위한
# 구결자(口訣字) 기초(基礎) 자료(資料) 구축(構築) 현황(現況)」, 『구결연구』 43, 263–287
# (https://kiss.kstudy.com/Detail/Ar?key=3721308), states the count and the placement. The code
# points are a convention between a document and a font, not a character assignment.
# Every code point was checked against Haansoft Dotum 1.21 (HanYang I&C, 2004), the font the free
# 구결자 at each of the 255. The font is a visual reference only and is not redistributed.
# readings: the 음가, and jibo: the 모자 (source hanja), are filled only from an openly licensed or
# cited source, named in a comment beside the rows it fills; both are empty until then.
